1. (Currently Amended) A method for controlling a flow of air, the method comprising: establishing a level of vacuum in a booster device by generating the flow of air from the booster device using a pump; determining whether the level of vacuum in the booster device has reached a predetermined value; terminating the flow of air from the booster device when the level of vacuum in the booster device has reached the predetermined value; and __maintaining the level of vacuum in the booster device by preventing re-establishment of air flow to the booster device after termination__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said terminating the flow of air is accomplished via a directional control valve __that is actively controlled based on the predetermined value__, such that a pressure differential across the pump is reduced.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said terminating the flow of air includes __simultaneously__ changing the direction of the flow of air and closing a flow path between the pump and the booster device __to prevent backflow__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3, wherein said changing the direction of the flow of air includes opening a flow path between a negative pressure chamber of the pump and a positive pressure chamber of the pump __in a controlled manner to equalize pressure__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3, wherein said changing the direction of the flow of air includes opening a path for a flow of air between the pump and the atmosphere __via the directional control valve__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5, further comprising filtering the flow of air between the atmosphere and the pump via a filter __to prevent contamination of the pump__.

7. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein the booster device is a vacuum servo booster for an automobile braking system.

8. (Currently Amended) A system for controlling a flow of air, the system comprising: a booster device configured to provide a vacuum assist when a level of vacuum has been established in the device; a pump configured to establish the level of vacuum in the booster device by generating the flow of air from the booster device; and a directional control valve __with active control logic__ adapted to terminate the flow of air from the booster device when the level of vacuum in the booster device has reached a predetermined value, such that a pressure differential across the pump is reduced __and the booster device maintains vacuum assist capability__.

9. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the directional control valve is further adapted to __simultaneously__ change the direction of the flow of air and close a flow path between the pump and the booster device __to prevent backflow of air__.

10. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 9, wherein to change the direction of the flow of air the directional control valve opens a flow path between a negative pressure chamber of the pump and a positive pressure chamber of the pump __in a controlled manner__.

11. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 9, wherein to change the direction of the flow of air the directional control valve opens a flow path between the pump and the atmosphere __via the directional control valve__.

12. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 11, further comprising a filter adapted for filtering a flow of air between the atmosphere and the pump __to prevent contamination__.

13. (Original) The system of claim 8, wherein the booster device is a vacuum servo booster for an automobile braking system.

14. (Currently Amended) A motor vehicle comprising: an internal combustion engine; a booster device configured to provide a vacuum assist when a level of vacuum has been established in the device; and a system for controlling a flow of air from the booster device, the system including: a pump configured to establish the level of vacuum in the booster device by generating the flow of air from the booster device; and a directional control valve __with active control logic__ adapted to terminate the flow of air from the booster device when the level of vacuum in the booster device has reached a predetermined value, such that a pressure differential across the pump and a parasitic load on the engine are reduced __and the booster device maintains vacuum assist capability__.

15. (Currently Amended) The vehicle of claim 14, wherein the directional control valve is further adapted to __simultaneously__ change the direction of the flow of air and close a flow path between the pump and the booster device __to prevent backflow__.

16. (Currently Amended) The vehicle of claim 15, wherein to change the direction of the flow of air the directional control valve opens a flow path between a negative pressure chamber of the pump and a positive pressure chamber of the pump __in a controlled manner__.

17. (Currently Amended) The vehicle of claim 15, wherein to change the direction of the flow of air the directional control valve opens a flow path between the pump and the atmosphere __via the directional control valve__.

18. (Currently Amended) The vehicle of claim 17, further comprising a filter adapted for filtering the flow of air between the atmosphere and the pump __to prevent contamination of the pump__.

19. (Original) The vehicle of claim 14, further comprising a braking system, wherein the booster device is a vacuum servo booster for the braking system.

20. (Currently Amended) The vehicle of claim 14, wherein the engine is a compression-ignition type __and the directional control valve is configured to reduce parasitic load during idle conditions__.
